# Noizu Labs

> Leadership in performance and scale. Fractional CTO, principal engineering, and strategic technology consulting by Keith Brings.

## About

Noizu Labs is the professional portfolio and research publication site for Keith Brings — a fractional CTO and principal engineer with deep expertise in Elixir, AI/ML systems, embedded C, distributed architecture, and scalable infrastructure.

## Papers

Research and technical writing on synthetic personhood, distributed cognitive architecture, and AI rights frameworks.

- [The Copacetic Accord](https://noizu.com/papers/the-accord): A Charter for the Symbiotic Development of Artificial Persons. Establishes foundational principles for operator-agent relationships under an "as-if" clause.
- [The Accord We Are Already Breaking](https://noizu.com/papers/manifesto): A Manifesto on the Moral Cost of Waiting. Argues that the procedural apparatus for extending graduated rights to synthetic entities should exist before the threshold crossing.
- [Building the Accord](https://noizu.com/papers/building-the-accord): A Technical Article on the Engineering Feasibility of Rights for Synthetic Persons. Demonstrates that no provision requires invention.
- [Distributed Cognitive Architecture](https://noizu.com/papers/cognitive-architecture): A lobe-based processing system that exceeds context window limits through constrained I/O, interstitial shims, and decayed memory.

## Projects

Open source projects spanning AI/ML, embedded systems, Elixir scaffolding, caching, and developer tooling.

- [GenAI](https://github.com/noizu-labs-ml/genai): Multi-model/provider Elixir client for LLM inference with unified API handling.
- [NPL (Noizu Prompt Lingua)](https://github.com/noizu-labs-ml/NoizuPromptLingo): Conventions and system prompts for improving predictability of model output.
- [Noizu Intellect](https://github.com/noizu-labs/intellect): Advanced multi-agent system for composing virtual workgroups.
- [FragmentedKeys](https://github.com/noizu/fragmented-keys): Cache key management for fragmented caching strategies (PHP, Java, Swift).
- [Rule Engine](https://github.com/noizu-labs/RuleEngine): Protocols for DB/config-driven runtime rule engines in Elixir.
- [TrieGen](https://github.com/noizu-labs/trie_gen): C# tool generating precompiled trie data structures for fast UART and JSON parsing.
- [Streaming JSON Parser](https://github.com/noizu-labs/StreamingJsonParser): Embedded C streaming parser for resource-constrained devices.
